findings.title: The stated performance NFR has no load-test task or CI gate
findings.description: The slice sets a target of adding under one second to a Phase 0 build, but the task breakdown explicitly rules out a load test and relies on cap tests instead. Add a load test under `tests/load/` that covers this target, plus a CI task that gates on it; the target and cap tests do not establish the timing requirement.

findings.title: Task 11 lacks an immediately following test task for MCP behavior
findings.description: Task 11 mixes pipeline implementation with `contextTools.test.ts` assertions instead of placing tests in a separate task immediately afterward. The required `context_build` response when the resolver throws `AdoptionError` is also not covered: the stated assertions check option values, while the parity and integration scenarios cover successful builds. Add a Task 11 test task directly after the implementation, covering both option forwarding and the D9 MCP error result.

findings.title: The integration-fixture task is too broad for one task
findings.description: Task 12 bundles a fixture harness and 13 integration scenarios spanning detection, state transitions, guide errors, non-concept phases, and read-only preview. Split it into focused integration tasks—for example, detection/state behavior and build/MCP integration—so each has a manageable, independently verifiable scope.

findings.title: Commit markers are formatted as checkboxes
findings.description: Every listed commit point uses a checkbox such as `- [ ] **Task 2C: Commit**`; none is a standalone plain `**Commit**:` line. Convert these to plain commit-marker lines at the existing tested checkpoints, rather than checkbox items.
